angebot.text: Uncle Alwin is off on a grand carrot cruise — and instead of selling, he presses a giant key into Gooby's paw. With a note: “The store likes you. Water the till twice a week.”
angebot.frage: Will you take over the little corner store?
angebot.zu_wenig: Not enough coins yet — the key costs {preis}. It waits patiently.

intro.zeile1: Uncle Alwin ran the little corner store for 40 years — today he hangs up his apron and leaves on a grand carrot cruise.
intro.zeile2: He presses a key into Gooby's paw that's bigger than his head. With a note: “The store likes you. Water the till twice a week.”
intro.zeile3: The door says “Goo!” on the way in and “Bye…” on the way out. From now on it's up to you: shelf by shelf, carrot by carrot, beep by beep.

laden.eingeraeumt: {kisten} crates stocked — storage is freshly filled!
laden.erst_einraeumen: Stock a shelf first — customers need something to grab!
laden.regal_voll: That slot is already full to the top.
laden.lager_leer: The storage is empty — get restock!

grossmarkt.hinfahrt: Once across town — to the ramp behind REHWEI.
grossmarkt.rueckfahrt: Trunk lid shut — and off home!
grossmarkt.staffel_hinweis: Bulk price: from {ab} of one item, −{prozent} % on that line.
grossmarkt.einraeumen_zeile: {kisten} crates for {betrag} coins — everything is already in storage.
grossmarkt.korb_leer: The cart is still empty — pick a pallet!
grossmarkt.kofferraum_voll: Nothing more fits in the trunk!
grossmarkt.not_enough_coins: Not quite enough coins for that.

preise.trend_hinweis: Customers grab trend items extra eagerly today — a good day for brave prices.
preise.lust_mittel: Customers think briefly — and usually take it anyway.
preise.lust_niedrig: Customers leave it on the shelf more often. Bold!

backofen.gebacken: {menge}× fresh bread out of the oven — the scent fills the whole store!
backofen.fertig: The oven is done for today — it bakes again tomorrow.
backofen.zu_teuer: Not quite enough coins for a batch.

alwin.spruch_1: Uncle Alwin knocks on the shelf: “Still standing. Good screw, 1987.”
alwin.spruch_2: Uncle Alwin: “That carrot and I are on a first-name basis.”
alwin.spruch_3: Uncle Alwin polishes a shelf board in passing. Connoisseur's glance.
alwin.spruch_4: Uncle Alwin: “Smells like the old days. Only the prices are younger.”
alwin.spruch_5: Uncle Alwin: “40 years of store, Gooby. The door likes you, I can hear it.”
alwin.spruch_6: Uncle Alwin holds a carrot up to the light: “Vintage produce.”
alwin.spruch_7: Uncle Alwin: “The cruise buffet had carrots. Not like yours.”
alwin.spruch_8: Uncle Alwin: “Neatly stocked. Almost as good as mine. Almost.”
alwin.sonderwunsch: Uncle Alwin: “Today… TWO carrots?! You only live once.”
alwin.leer: Uncle Alwin finds no carrot. He says nothing. The look says everything.
alwin.belohnung: Alwin streak {streak}! He slips you {betrag} coins: “For the store. Not for sweets.”

abschluss.untertitel: Lights out, the door whispers “Bye…” — time to count.
abschluss.verpasst: {anzahl}× someone found an empty shelf — that sold out fast!
